# Subway Builder - Berlin Map

---

## Description:
> Bring the subway to Berlin! Build a working subway network in the capital of Germany. Over 800.000 commuters want to go to their workplace and it's your job to get them there! Based on real-life demand data from [mobilithek.info](https://mobilithek.info/offers/767359761906577408) (Latest access: 6th July 2026).
## Features:
- **Size**: 45x40km / 1783.2sq/km
- **Real data**: Real-world demand data from mobilithek.info, utilizing the official 1x1km statistical grid.
- **Real routes and volume**: Commuter routes and their volume are strictly derived from the statistical data of the German Government (BMV/Mobilithek).
- **Demand Accuracy**: Macro-level grid demand is paired with OpenStreetMap (OSM) building data, anchoring the statistical commuter numbers to real-world physical starting points and destinations.
- **Performance Optimized**: Low-density routes with fewer than 15 commuters have been filtered out to keep simulation performance smooth.
- **In-Game data**: 895,969 residents | 895,969 jobs
data_source: BMV (mobilithek), (OMV - only for realdworld building locations mapping)
